title: Record the negacyclic sign cancellation
body:
## Summary
- Substituting `x = zeta y` with `zeta^r = -1` wraps the exponent and the degree together, so the two minus signs cancel.
- All 22,369,620 exponent pairs through `r = 4096` keep that cancellation, and all 65,808 binary polynomial products at `r = 2, 4, 8` agree on the cyclic and negacyclic sides.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
